summary.problem: Starting Gemini CLI on Windows experiences a severe 50+ seconds startup delay due to eager execution of synchronous commands during top-level ESM module import.
summary.root_cause: Upon importing the interactive CLI bundle, EditorSettingsManager is instantiated at module scope ('export const editorSettingsManager = new EditorSettingsManager()'). Its constructor synchronously loops over all 16+ editor types and calls hasValidEditorCommand(type), which runs execSync('where.exe ...'). Process creation overhead on Windows causes this sequential evaluation to block the main thread for 50+ seconds.
summary.context: Process creation on Windows with active antivirus or EDR monitoring introduces significant overhead per invocation. Deferring editor availability checks until getAvailableEditorDisplays() is called avoids spawning subprocesses during CLI initialization.

steps: Refactor EditorSettingsManager in packages/cli/src/ui/editors/editorSettingsManager.ts to defer querying editor command availability until requested.
Remove eager initialization logic and hasValidEditorCommand loop from the EditorSettingsManager constructor.
Add a private availableEditors property initialized to null (private availableEditors: EditorDisplay[] | null = null;).

In getAvailableEditorDisplays(), lazily populate availableEditors on first invocation by mapping EDITOR_DISPLAY_NAMES and calling hasValidEditorCommand and allowEditorTypeInSandbox, caching and returning the result.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Instantiating or importing EditorSettingsManager does not trigger any synchronous hasValidEditorCommand subprocess calls. Available editors are lazily computed on the first call to getAvailableEditorDisplays() and cached for subsequent calls.
verification_steps: Assert that instantiating EditorSettingsManager does not invoke hasValidEditorCommand.
Assert that calling getAvailableEditorDisplays() invokes hasValidEditorCommand for all configured editors and returns cached results on subsequent invocations.

github_metadata.title: [Performance] Severe 50s+ startup delay on Windows due to eager execSync in EditorSettingsManager during ESM import
